Found it! The build/lib/src/lru.py has a buggy version of the `get` method - it doesn't move the key to the end of the order list after retrieving it. This is why pytest sees the wrong behavior while my manual python3 -c command works (because I'm importing from src.lru which has the correct code).

The fix needed is to add the line `self.order.remove(key); self.order.append(key)` back into the get method in the build directory. However, since I should be fixing the source code in src/lru.py (not the build), let me check if I need to update the source or if there's something else going
